# Palette reduction

Repaints the image with only the colors of a classic palette (Game Boy, CGA, EGA, PICO-8, Commodore 64, NES, or four of your own), matched by perceived difference, with optional dithering.

<EffectDemo effect="palette" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { palette } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/palette';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(palette({ preset: 'gameBoy' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.palette = 'pico8'`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling; parameters marked _structural_ recompile the pass that contains the effect.

## Parameters

| Parameter                | Type                                                                 | Default     | Range     | Description                                       |
| ------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `palette` _(structural)_ | 'gameBoy' \| 'cga' \| 'ega' \| 'pico8' \| 'c64' \| 'nes' \| 'custom' | `'pico8'`   |           | The palette to repaint with.                      |
| `dither`                 | number                                                               | `0.5`       | 0 – 1     | Ordered dithering between palette colors.         |
| `pixelSize`              | number                                                               | `1`         | 1 – 16 px | Size of each output pixel.                        |
| `color1`                 | hex color                                                            | `'#1a1c2c'` |           | Custom palette: first color.                      |
| `color2`                 | hex color                                                            | `'#5d275d'` |           | Custom palette: second color.                     |
| `color3`                 | hex color                                                            | `'#ef7d57'` |           | Custom palette: third color.                      |
| `color4`                 | hex color                                                            | `'#f4f4f4'` |           | Custom palette: fourth color.                     |
| `amount`                 | number                                                               | `1`         | 0 – 1     | Mix between the original and the repainted image. |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset    | Settings                                            |
| --------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `gameBoy` | `palette: 'gameBoy'`, `pixelSize: 2`, `dither: 0.6` |
| `cga`     | `palette: 'cga'`, `pixelSize: 2`, `dither: 0.8`     |
| `nes`     | `palette: 'nes'`, `pixelSize: 3`, `dither: 0.2`     |
| `c64`     | `palette: 'c64'`, `pixelSize: 3`, `dither: 0.4`     |

Apply one with `palette({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Retro & display · tracked as story X7.6 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Cost:** 77.0 ms added to a 960×540 frame on CI container (SwiftShader software renderer) (2026-10-11). A software renderer: use it to compare effects, not to predict GPU times.
- **Size:** 8.6 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/palette`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Nearest-color matching in OKLab (Ottosson, 2020); Palettes: Nintendo Game Boy (DMG), IBM CGA mode 4 palette 1 (high intensity), IBM EGA 16 colors, PICO-8 (Lexaloffle), Commodore 64 (Pepto), NES 2C02 (common approximation).

## Related

- [Dither](./dither) — Reduces each channel to a few levels and hides the banding with a dither pattern: ordered Bayer matrices, void-and-cluster blue noise, or interleaved gradient noise.
- [Bit crush](./bit-crush) — Throws away color depth (and optionally resolution), like a frame buffer with too few bits: smooth gradients turn into bands.
- [Pixelate](./pixelate) — Big square, hexagonal or round pixels, each the color at its center.
